operations.title: The physical C4 q_G infinity point is a rank-one threefold node
operations.body: In the y4=1 chart, dDelta/du has determinant -8. The branch quadratic has Hessian determinant -8 det(G)^2, so away from existing Gram support the quartic double solid has local form W^2=u1^2+u2^2+u3^2, Milnor number one, and a rank-one H3 vanishing cycle.
